source: PSKai v6.545 pseudosat_kai/pseudo_bram.c:1203-1223 (the product numbers Kai skips per-game saves for), BackupMngr/app_title.h:19-31 (Save Data Manager title), autoset.c:198-224 and 1876-1913 (IP dumps); smk_readme 6b lines 225-230; main readme v6.521 lines 2419-2423; Save Game Copier 3.6.18 release game.iso IP read 2026-11-20
schema: title_substring: upper-case text searched for in the upper-cased IP title (0x60-0xDF); empty string when the tool's title is generic and must not be used. product_codes: IP product numbers (0x20, 10 bytes, cut at the first space as Kai does) compared exactly. A disc is a save tool if its title contains a non-empty title_substring OR its product number is in product_codes.
